verdict.rationale: Synthesia is a video-generation SaaS, so user-configurable background automations are a fair axis, but the pack shows no first-party automation, trigger or scheduling feature. The asynchronous Video API, completion webhooks and the MCP server are developer building blocks or integrations that a user could wire into their own automation. They are not a product capability for setting up autonomous recurring workflows, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
